nights.title: Lane 8 - Europe Tour
nights.name: Lane 8
nights.extract: Daniel Goldstein, better known by his stage name Lane 8, is an American musician, DJ, and electronic music producer. Currently residing in Denver, Colorado, he is signed to English deep house label Anjunadeep. Pete Tong named Lane 8 a "Future Star" and Dancing Astronaut included him in their '25 Artists to Watch in 2015'. His debut studio album Rise, was released on July 17, 2015. More recently, he has been releasing music through his own label This Never Happened.

en.kicker: american dj and electronic music producer · denver
en.who: Daniel Goldstein, better known as Lane 8, is an American musician, DJ, and electronic music producer. More recently he has released music through his own label, This Never Happened.
facts: Currently residing in Denver, Colorado, he is signed to English deep house label Anjunadeep.
His debut studio album Rise, was released on July 17, 2015.

de.who: Daniel Goldstein, besser bekannt als Lane 8, ist ein amerikanischer Musiker, DJ und Produzent elektronischer Musik. Zuletzt veröffentlicht er über sein eigenes Label This Never Happened.
facts: Derzeit in Denver, Colorado, ansässig, steht er beim englischen Deep-House-Label Anjunadeep unter Vertrag.
Sein Debütalbum Rise erschien am 17. Juli 2015.

tr.kicker: amerikalı dj ve elektronik müzik yapımcısı · denver
tr.who: Daniel Goldstein, Lane 8 sahne adıyla daha çok tanınan, Amerikalı bir müzisyen, DJ ve elektronik müzik yapımcısıdır. Son dönemde kendi etiketi This Never Happened üzerinden müzik yayımlıyor.
facts: Halen Colorado'nun Denver kentinde yaşıyor ve İngiliz deep house plak şirketi Anjunadeep ile sözleşmeli.
Debut stüdyo albümü Rise, 17 Temmuz 2015'te yayımlandı.

nights.title: DON TOLIVER: NITROUS - OCTANE WORLD TOUR LEG 2
nights.name: Don Toliver
nights.extract: Caleb Zackery "Don" Toliver is an American rapper, singer and songwriter. His debut mixtape, Donny Womack (2018), was released one day prior to fellow Houston rapper Travis Scott's album Astroworld, on which Toliver made a guest appearance. In the following week, he signed with Scott's record label, Cactus Jack Records, in a joint venture with Atlantic Records.

en.who: Caleb Zackery "Don" Toliver is an American rapper, singer and songwriter from Houston. He appeared as a guest on Travis Scott's album Astroworld.
facts: His debut mixtape, Donny Womack (2018), was released one day prior to fellow Houston rapper Travis Scott's album Astroworld, on which Toliver made a guest appearance.
In the following week, he signed with Scott's record label, Cactus Jack Records, in a joint venture with Atlantic Records.

de.who: Caleb Zackery „Don“ Toliver ist ein amerikanischer Rapper, Sänger und Songwriter aus Houston. Er hatte einen Gastauftritt auf Travis Scotts Album Astroworld.
facts: Sein Debüt-Mixtape Donny Womack (2018) erschien einen Tag vor Astroworld, dem Album des Houstoner Rappers Travis Scott, auf dem Toliver als Gast zu hören ist.
In der darauffolgenden Woche unterschrieb er bei Scotts Label Cactus Jack Records in einem Joint Venture mit Atlantic Records.

tr.who: Caleb Zackery “Don” Toliver, Houston'lı Amerikalı bir rapçi, şarkıcı ve söz yazarıdır. Travis Scott'ın Astroworld albümünde konuk olarak yer aldı.
facts: Debut mixtape'i Donny Womack (2018), Houstonlu rapçi Travis Scott'ın Astroworld albümünden bir gün önce yayımlandı; Toliver bu albümde konuk sanatçı olarak yer aldı.
Ardından gelen haftada Scott'ın plak şirketi Cactus Jack Records ile Atlantic Records ortaklığında sözleşme imzaladı.

nights.title: J. Cole: The Fall-Off Tour
nights.name: J. Cole
nights.extract: Jermaine Lamarr Cole is an American rapper and record producer. Born on a military base in Germany and raised in Fayetteville, North Carolina, Cole initially gained attention as a rapper following the release of his debut mixtape, The Come Up, in early 2007. He attended college in New York City with intent in furthering his musical career, and signed with Jay-Z's Roc Nation in 2009; the label released his next two mixtapes: The Warm Up (2009) and Friday Night Lights (2010), both of which earned him wider recognition.

en.who: Jermaine Lamarr Cole is an American rapper and record producer. He was born on a military base in Germany and raised in Fayetteville, North Carolina.
facts: Born on a military base in Germany and raised in Fayetteville, North Carolina, Cole initially gained attention as a rapper following the release of his debut mixtape, The Come Up, in early 2007.

He attended college in New York City with intent in furthering his musical career, and signed with Jay-Z's Roc Nation in 2009; the label released his next two mixtapes: The Warm Up (2009) and Friday Night Lights (2010), both of which earned him wider recognition.

de.who: Jermaine Lamarr Cole ist ein amerikanischer Rapper und Musikproduzent. Er kam auf einem Militärstützpunkt in Deutschland zur Welt und wuchs in Fayetteville, North Carolina, auf.
facts: Auf einem Militärstützpunkt in Deutschland geboren und in Fayetteville, North Carolina, aufgewachsen, wurde Cole als Rapper erstmals nach der Veröffentlichung seines Debüt-Mixtapes The Come Up Anfang 2007 bekannt.

Er studierte in New York City und unterschrieb 2009 bei Jay-Zs Label Roc Nation; das Label veröffentlichte seine nächsten beiden Mixtapes, The Warm Up (2009) und Friday Night Lights (2010), die ihm größere Anerkennung einbrachten.

tr.who: Jermaine Lamarr Cole, Amerikalı bir rapçi ve plak yapımcısıdır. Almanya'da bir askeri üste doğdu ve Kuzey Carolina'nın Fayetteville kentinde büyüdü.
facts: Almanya'da bir askeri üste doğup Kuzey Carolina'nın Fayetteville kentinde büyüyen Cole, 2007 başında debut mixtape'i The Come Up'ın yayımlanmasının ardından rapçi olarak ilk kez ilgi gördü.

New York'ta müzik kariyerini ilerletme niyetiyle üniversiteye gitti; 2009'da Jay-Z'nin Roc Nation şirketiyle sözleşme imzaladı. Şirket sonraki iki mixtape'ini yayımladı: The Warm Up (2009) ve Friday Night Lights (2010); ikisi de kendisine daha geniş tanınırlık kazandırdı.

nights.title: Montell Fish - The Nest Tour
nights.name: Montell Fish
nights.extract: Montell James Frazier, also known as Montell Fish, is an American singer-songwriter. Formerly making music under the CCM genre, he switched to alternative R&B and neo soul. He has since signed to Virgin Music Group for distribution and released two albums under the deal: Jamie in 2022 and Charlotte in 2024.

en.who: Montell James Frazier, also known as Montell Fish, is an American singer-songwriter. He formerly made music in the CCM genre before switching to alternative R&B and neo soul.
facts: Formerly making music under the CCM genre, he switched to alternative R&B and neo soul.
He has since signed to Virgin Music Group for distribution and released two albums under the deal: Jamie in 2022 and Charlotte in 2024.

de.who: Montell James Frazier, auch bekannt als Montell Fish, ist ein amerikanischer Singer-Songwriter. Früher machte er Musik im CCM-Genre, bevor er zu Alternative R&B und Neo-Soul wechselte.
facts: Früher machte er Musik im CCM-Genre, dann wechselte er zu Alternative R&B und Neo-Soul.
Seitdem hat er einen Vertrag mit der Virgin Music Group für den Vertrieb unterzeichnet und im Rahmen dieses Deals zwei Alben veröffentlicht: Jamie 2022 und Charlotte 2024.

tr.who: Montell James Frazier, Montell Fish olarak da bilinen Amerikalı bir singer-songwriter'dır. Daha önce CCM türünde müzik yapıyordu; sonra alternatif R&B ve neo soul'a yöneldi.
facts: Daha önce CCM türünde müzik yaparken alternatif R&B ve neo soul'a yöneldi.
Ardından dağıtım için Virgin Music Group ile anlaşma imzaladı ve bu anlaşma kapsamında Jamie (2022) ile Charlotte (2024) adlı iki albüm yayımladı.

nights.title: Nick Hakim - I Can See Live: In Concert
nights.name: Nick Hakim
nights.extract: Nicolas Hakim is an American musician based in Queens, New York, United States. His first EP, Where Will We Go Part 1 & 2, was self-released in 2014. He released three albums with ATO: Green Twins (2017), Will This Make Me Good (2020), and Cometa (2022).

en.who: Nicolas Hakim is an American musician based in Queens, New York, United States. He has released albums with the label ATO.
facts: His first EP, Where Will We Go Part 1 & 2, was self-released in 2014.
He released three albums with ATO: Green Twins (2017), Will This Make Me Good (2020), and Cometa (2022).

de.who: Nicolas Hakim ist ein amerikanischer Musiker mit Wohnsitz in Queens, New York, USA. Er hat Alben beim Label ATO veröffentlicht.
facts: Seine erste EP, Where Will We Go Part 1 & 2, erschien 2014 im Eigenverlag.
Er veröffentlichte drei Alben bei ATO: Green Twins (2017), Will This Make Me Good (2020) und Cometa (2022).

tr.who: Nicolas Hakim, New York'un Queens semtinde yaşayan Amerikalı bir müzisyendir. ATO plak şirketi ile albümler yayımladı.
facts: İlk EP'si Where Will We Go Part 1 & 2, 2014 yılında kendi imkânlarıyla yayımlandı.
ATO ile üç albüm yayımladı: Green Twins (2017), Will This Make Me Good (2020) ve Cometa (2022).

nights.title: Koza Mostra
nights.name: Koza Mostra
nights.extract: Koza Mostra is a Greek rock band founded in 2012. It consists of Ilias Kozas, Dimitris Raptis (drums), Stavros Apostolidis, Giannis Bellos, Sofia Staikou and Asterios Fragos. The band fuses ska, punk, and rock music together with the style of traditional Greek folk music such as Macedonian Greek music and rebetiko.

en.who: Koza Mostra is a Greek rock band founded in 2012. Its members include Ilias Kozas and Dimitris Raptis, who plays drums.
facts: It consists of Ilias Kozas, Dimitris Raptis (drums), Stavros Apostolidis, Giannis Bellos, Sofia Staikou and Asterios Fragos.
The band fuses ska, punk, and rock music together with the style of traditional Greek folk music such as Macedonian Greek music and rebetiko.

de.who: Koza Mostra ist eine griechische Rockband, die 2012 gegründet wurde. Zu ihr gehören unter anderem Ilias Kozas und Dimitris Raptis am Schlagzeug.
facts: Zur Band gehören Ilias Kozas, Dimitris Raptis (Schlagzeug), Stavros Apostolidis, Giannis Bellos, Sofia Staikou und Asterios Fragos.
Die Band verbindet Ska, Punk und Rock mit dem Stil traditioneller griechischer Volksmusik wie der makedonisch-griechischen Musik und dem Rebetiko.

tr.who: Koza Mostra, 2012 yılında kurulmuş bir Yunan rock grubudur. Kadrosunda Ilias Kozas ve davulcu Dimitris Raptis yer alıyor.
facts: Kadroda Ilias Kozas, Dimitris Raptis (davul), Stavros Apostolidis, Giannis Bellos, Sofia Staikou ve Asterios Fragos bulunuyor.
Grup ska, punk ve rock müziğini; Makedon-Yunan müziği ve rebetiko gibi geleneksel Yunan halk müziği tarzıyla harmanlıyor.

nights.title: Digitalism - OPTIMISM TOUR 2026
nights.name: Digitalism
nights.extract: Digitalism are a German electronic music duo formed in Hamburg by Jens Moelle and İsmail Tüfekçi in 2004. The duo are signed to French label Kitsuné, as well as Virgin Records and Astralwerks in other parts of the world.

en.who: Jens Moelle and İsmail Tüfekçi formed the duo in Hamburg in 2004. In other parts of the world the duo is signed to Virgin Records and Astralwerks.
facts: Digitalism are a German electronic music duo formed in Hamburg by Jens Moelle and İsmail Tüfekçi in 2004.
The duo are signed to French label Kitsuné, as well as Virgin Records and Astralwerks in other parts of the world.

de.who: Jens Moelle und İsmail Tüfekçi gründeten das Duo 2004 in Hamburg. In anderen Teilen der Welt ist es bei Virgin Records und Astralwerks unter Vertrag.
facts: Digitalism sind ein deutsches Electronic-Music-Duo, das 2004 in Hamburg von Jens Moelle und İsmail Tüfekçi gegründet wurde.
Das Duo steht beim französischen Label Kitsuné unter Vertrag sowie in anderen Teilen der Welt bei Virgin Records und Astralwerks.

tr.who: Jens Moelle ve İsmail Tüfekçi ikiliyi 2004'te Hamburg'da kurdu. Dünyanın diğer bölgelerinde ikili Virgin Records ve Astralwerks ile sözleşmeli.
facts: Digitalism, 2004 yılında Hamburg'da Jens Moelle ve İsmail Tüfekçi tarafından kurulan bir Alman elektronik müzik ikilisidir.
İkili Fransız Kitsuné plak şirketiyle sözleşmeli; dünyanın diğer bölgelerinde ise Virgin Records ve Astralwerks ile de sözleşmeli.

nights.title: glaive - God Save The Three Tour
nights.name: Glaive
nights.extract: Ash Blue Gutierrez, known professionally as Glaive, is an American singer-songwriter. After posting a string of hyperpop songs to SoundCloud during the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic that earned him a following, he signed a record deal with Interscope Records and released his debut extended play, Cypress Grove, in 2020. His debut album, I Care So Much That I Don't Care at All, was released in 2023. His second album, May It Never Falter, was released in 2024. His third, Y'all, was released in September 2025. His fourth, a collaborative album with Kurtains called God Save the Three, was released in May 2026.

en.who: Ash Blue Gutierrez, known professionally as Glaive, is an American singer-songwriter. He signed a record deal with Interscope Records after posting hyperpop songs to SoundCloud.
facts: After posting a string of hyperpop songs to SoundCloud during the beginning of the COVID-19 pandemic that earned him a following, he signed a record deal with Interscope Records and released his debut extended play, Cypress Grove, in 2020.
His fourth, a collaborative album with Kurtains called God Save the Three, was released in May 2026.

de.who: Ash Blue Gutierrez, bekannt als Glaive, ist ein amerikanischer Singer-Songwriter. Nachdem er Hyperpop-Songs auf SoundCloud veröffentlicht hatte, unterschrieb er einen Plattenvertrag bei Interscope Records.
facts: Nachdem er zu Beginn der COVID-19-Pandemie eine Reihe von Hyperpop-Songs auf SoundCloud veröffentlicht hatte, die ihm eine Fangemeinde einbrachten, unterschrieb er bei Interscope Records und veröffentlichte 2020 seine Debüt-EP Cypress Grove.
Sein viertes Album, eine Zusammenarbeit mit Kurtains namens God Save the Three, erschien im Mai 2026.

tr.who: Ash Blue Gutierrez, Glaive adıyla tanınan Amerikalı bir singer-songwriter'dır. SoundCloud'a hyperpop şarkıları yüklemesinin ardından Interscope Records ile plak anlaşması imzaladı.
facts: COVID-19 pandemisinin başlarında SoundCloud'a bir dizi hyperpop şarkısı yükleyip hayran kitlesi kazandıktan sonra Interscope Records ile anlaşma imzaladı ve 2020'de debut EP'si Cypress Grove'u yayımladı.
Dördüncü albümü God Save the Three, Kurtains ile yaptığı ortak bir albüm olarak Mayıs 2026'da yayımlandı.

nights.title: ElGrandeToto - SALGOAT WORLD TOUR 2
nights.name: ElGrandeToto
nights.extract: Taha Fahssi, better known by his stage name ElGrandeToto, EGT or just Toto, is a Moroccan rapper from Casablanca. He has been the most streamed artist in Morocco for five consecutive years (2021-2025) and was the most listened-to artist in the MENA region on Spotify in 2021 and 2023. He is also the most viewed Moroccan rapper on YouTube. Fahssi is widely regarded as one of Morocco's best rappers of all time.

en.who: Taha Fahssi, better known by his stage name ElGrandeToto, is a Moroccan rapper from Casablanca. He is widely regarded as one of Morocco's best rappers of all time.
facts: He has been the most streamed artist in Morocco for five consecutive years (2021-2025) and was the most listened-to artist in the MENA region on Spotify in 2021 and 2023.

de.who: Taha Fahssi, besser bekannt unter seinem Künstlernamen ElGrandeToto, ist ein marokkanischer Rapper aus Casablanca. Er gilt als einer der besten Rapper Marokkos aller Zeiten.
facts: Er war fünf Jahre in Folge (2021–2025) der meistgestreamte Künstler in Marokko und 2021 sowie 2023 der meistgehörte Künstler der MENA-Region auf Spotify.
Außerdem ist er der meistgesehene marokkanische Rapper auf YouTube.

tr.who: Taha Fahssi, ElGrandeToto sahne adıyla daha çok tanınan, Casablanca'dan bir Fas rapçisidir. Fas'ın tüm zamanların en iyi rapçilerinden biri olarak geniş çapta kabul edilir.
facts: Beş yıl üst üste (2021–2025) Fas'ta en çok dinlenen sanatçı oldu; 2021 ve 2023'te Spotify'da MENA bölgesinde en çok dinlenen sanatçı olarak da öne çıktı.
YouTube'da en çok izlenen Fas'lı rapçi de odur.

nights.title: Artemas - LOVERCORE / GETTING UP TO NO GOOD Tour
nights.name: Artemas
nights.extract: Artemas Diamandis, known mononymously as Artemas, is an English singer, songwriter and record producer. He is best known for his singles "If U Think I'm Pretty" and the viral "I Like the Way You Kiss Me". He is signed to the record label 10K Projects.

en.kicker: english singer, songwriter and record producer

facts: He is best known for his singles "If U Think I'm Pretty" and the viral "I Like the Way You Kiss Me".

nights.title: Kodaline - Farewell Tour
nights.name: Kodaline
nights.extract: Kodaline are an Irish rock band. Originally known as 21 Demands, the band adopted their current name in 2012 to coincide with the changing of their music. The group comprises Steve Garrigan, Vincent May, Mark Prendergast, and Jason Boland.

en.who: Kodaline are an Irish rock band whose members include Steve Garrigan and Vincent May. The band first went by the name 21 Demands.
facts: Originally known as 21 Demands, the band adopted their current name in 2012 to coincide with the changing of their music.

de.who: Kodaline sind eine irische Rockband. Sie traten zunächst unter dem Namen 21 Demands auf, bevor sie 2012 ihren heutigen Namen annahmen.
facts: Ursprünglich als 21 Demands bekannt, nahm die Band 2012 ihren heutigen Namen an, um mit dem Wandel ihrer Musik zusammenzufallen.

tr.who: Kodaline, İrlandalı bir rock grubudur. Grup başlangıçta 21 Demands adıyla biliniyordu ve 2012'de bugünkü adını aldı.
facts: Başlangıçta 21 Demands olarak bilinen grup, müziğindeki değişimle aynı zamana denk gelmek için 2012'de bugünkü adını benimsedi.

nights.title: CHLOE SLATER - riot youth tour
nights.name: Chloe Slater
nights.extract: Chloe Leanne Slater is an English singer-songwriter based in Manchester. Writing about social and political issues, she has been releasing music since 2023 and has issued two extended plays: You Can't Put a Price on Fun, and Love Me Please.

nights.title: Ben Folds - Paper Airplane Request Tour 2026
nights.name: Ben Folds
nights.extract: Benjamin Scott Folds is an American singer-songwriter. After playing in several small independent bands from the late 1980s through the early '90s, Folds came to prominence as the frontman and pianist of the alternative rock trio Ben Folds Five from 1993 to 2000, their first reunion from 2011 to 2013, and since 2026. He has also collaborated with musicians such as Regina Spektor, "Weird Al" Yankovic and yMusic, and undertaken experimental songwriting projects with actor William Shatner and authors such as Nick Hornby and Neil Gaiman. Folds was the artistic advisor to the National Symphony Orchestra at the Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C. from 2017 until 2025.

en.who: Benjamin Scott Folds is an American singer-songwriter. He was the frontman and pianist of the alternative rock trio Ben Folds Five from 1993 to 2000.
facts: He has also collaborated with musicians such as Regina Spektor, "Weird Al" Yankovic and yMusic, and undertaken experimental songwriting projects with actor William Shatner and authors such as Nick Hornby and Neil Gaiman.

de.who: Benjamin Scott Folds ist ein amerikanischer Singer-Songwriter. Von 1993 bis 2000 war er Frontmann und Pianist des Alternative-Rock-Trios Ben Folds Five.
facts: Er hat mit Musikern wie Regina Spektor, „Weird Al“ Yankovic und yMusic zusammengearbeitet und experimentelle Songwriting-Projekte mit Schauspieler William Shatner sowie mit Autoren wie Nick Hornby und Neil Gaiman unternommen.
Von 2017 bis 2025 war Folds künstlerischer Berater des National Symphony Orchestra am Kennedy Center in Washington, D.C.

tr.who: Benjamin Scott Folds, Amerikalı bir singer-songwriter'dır. 1993'ten 2000'e kadar alternatif rock üçlüsü Ben Folds Five'ın ön sanatçısı ve piyanisti oldu.
facts: Regina Spektor, “Weird Al” Yankovic ve yMusic gibi müzisyenlerle işbirliği yaptı; oyuncu William Shatner ile Nick Hornby ve Neil Gaiman gibi yazarlarla deneysel şarkı yazma projelerine girişti.
2017'den 2025'e kadar Washington D.C.'deki Kennedy Center'da National Symphony Orchestra'nın sanatsal danışmanı olarak görev yaptı.

nights.title: Polyphia - BE NOT AFRAID World Tour
nights.name: Polyphia
nights.extract: Polyphia is an American rock band based in Plano, Texas, formed in 2010. The group consists of guitarists Tim Henson and Scott LePage, bassist Clay Gober, and drummer Clay Aeschliman. Rooted in a heavy metal sound in their early releases, the band's music evolved into a more progressive rock style in their later productions, combining elements of electronic and hip-hop music. Polyphia has released five studio albums, one live record, two EPs, and numerous singles.

en.who: Polyphia is an American rock band based in Plano, Texas, formed in 2010. The group consists of guitarists Tim Henson and Scott LePage, bassist Clay Gober, and drummer Clay Aeschliman.
facts: Rooted in a heavy metal sound in their early releases, the band's music evolved into a more progressive rock style in their later productions, combining elements of electronic and hip-hop music.

facts: Während die frühen Veröffentlichungen im Heavy Metal wurzelten, entwickelte sich die Musik in den späteren Produktionen zu einem progressiveren Rockstil, der Elemente von elektronischer Musik und Hip-Hop verbindet.
Polyphia hat fünf Studioalben, ein Livealbum, zwei EPs und zahlreiche Singles veröffentlicht.

tr.who: Polyphia, 2010 yılında kurulmuş, Teksas'ın Plano kentinde yerleşik bir Amerikan rock grubudur. Kadroda gitaristler Tim Henson ve Scott LePage, basçı Clay Gober ve davulcu Clay Aeschliman yer alıyor.
facts: İlk yayımlarında heavy metal sesine dayanan grubun müziği, sonraki yapımlarında elektronik ve hip-hop öğelerini harmanlayan daha progresif bir rock tarzına evrildi.
Polyphia beş stüdyo albümü, bir canlı kayıt, iki EP ve çok sayıda single yayımladı.
